description.value: Ahtsik Native Art Gallery is a premier Indigenous art destination founded in 2008 by master carver Gordon Dick of the Tseshaht First Nation, located along the Pacific Rim Highway in the Alberni Valley. The gallery showcases traditional Northwest Coast art from Nuu-chah-nulth, Kwakiutl, and Coast Salish nations, and visitors can observe Dick working in his open carving studio. For cyclists riding the route to Tofino, it offers a meaningful cultural stop that connects the art to the land and living traditions of the region.
